headline: 128 deliberate energy-sector attacks in the past week, 219 incidents damaging energy infrastructure

sources: Reuters report carried by Deccan Herald (byline: Reuters); statement by Deputy Energy Minister Artem Nekrasov
fault_line: Negotiate in the dark? Russia hits the grid 128 times in a week as talks open in Abu Dhabi -- pressure tactic or war crime?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- the statement] Russian attacks on energy facilities over the past 24 hours left some consumers without electricity in 12 Ukrainian regions, Deputy Energy Minister Artem Nekrasov said on Monday. The affected regions: Vinnytsia, Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zhytomyr, Zaporizhzhia, Kyiv, Odesa, Poltava, Rivne, Kharkiv, Khmelnytskyi and Chernihiv. 'Due to significant damage, the situation remains most difficult in the Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv regions,' Nekrasov said. [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- ministry] The ministry said Russia had deliberately attacked Ukraine's energy and oil and gas sectors 128 times over the past week; 219 incidents damaging or destroying energy and oil and gas infrastructure have been recorded. [ATTRIBUTED REPORT -- context] Follows the overnight Nov 8-9 wave recorded at 1500-04: 317 Russian drones (105 jet-powered), 276 intercepted, hits at 31 locations, 28 injured; Kyiv residents on 2-3 hours of electricity a day (RFI correspondent, via aggregator).
sections.what_verified: 1 declared-tier family for the 12-region/128-attack figures (Reuters T1, via Deccan Herald carry). Kyiv Independent (T2) corroborates the overnight energy attacks in substance but does not carry the 12-region count. Europesays repeats the same Reuters report and is an aggregator, not a distinct family.
sections.what_disputed: Russian Defence Ministry claims it struck only facilities supporting Ukraine's military-industrial complex and that its air defences downed 430 Ukrainian drones (vs Kyiv's 317 launched) -- drone counts conflict and are timing/methodology artifacts; no independent count of the 12 regions exists. Moscow denies deliberately targeting civilian infrastructure.
sections.why_matters: 12 regions dark, 128 hits in a week -- Ukraine walks into Abu Dhabi with its grid on life support.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP -- Ukraine grid: Russian attacks leave consumers without power in 12 regions; 128 deliberate energy-sector attacks in the past week, 219 incidents damaging energy infrastructure (Deputy Energy Minister Nekrasov, via Reuters)

totw_analysis: Our read: 12 regions dark, 128 hits in a week -- Ukraine walks into Abu Dhabi with its grid on life support. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Negotiate in the dark? Russia hits the grid 128 times in a week as talks open in Abu Dhabi -- pressure tactic or war crime?
